asked.item: Credits used by scheduling about 300 posts a month
Credits used when posts have your own photos

verdict.reason: The FAQ says scheduling posts and uploading your own images or videos do not use credits, and that credits are only used for AI-generated images and videos.

steps.text: Publishing or scheduling posts does not use credits.
Uploading your own images or videos does not use credits.
Credits are only used for AI-generated images and videos.
